form.publishedToast: Form v{{version}} is published. New inspections use it from now on.
form.discardDescription: Every change in the draft is lost. The published form stays as it is.

readOnly.title: The published form no longer changes
readOnly.text: Create a draft to change the categories, weights or questions. Inspections already started keep the version they began with.

weightsInvalid.title: The weights must total 100%
weightsInvalid.text: They now total {{sum}}%. Adjust them to publish.

category.removeDescription_one: Its question is deleted from the draft too.
category.removeDescription_other: Its {{count}} questions are deleted from the draft too.

dialog.description: The name appears on the inspector's phone and in the book.

question.removeDescription: The question disappears from the draft. Published versions do not change.

empty.title: This category has no questions
empty.description: Add at least one question to publish the form.

points.title: Answer points
points.hint: N/A does not count. A category's grade is the average of its answers; the final grade is the weighted average of the categories.

empty.title: There is no form yet
empty.description: Create a draft to add the inspection's categories and questions.

consent.helper: Shown on the inspector's phone before the inspection.
consent.removeDescription: The section disappears from the draft, in both languages.

notice.title: Older signatures keep their version
notice.text: Every signed PDF stays linked to the text the owner saw. The new version applies only to inspections that start after it is published.

consent.publishedToast: Version {{version}} is published. New inspections use it from now on.
consent.discardDescription: Changes in the draft are lost. The published version stays as it is.

readOnly.title: The published version no longer changes
readOnly.text: Create a draft to change the texts. Inspections already started keep the version that was signed.

empty.title: There are no consent texts yet
empty.description: Create a draft and add the sections the owner signs.
